def solve_dp(N, A):
    # DP Definitions:
    # S_pos(i): Maximum positive sum ending exactly at index i.
    # S_neg(i): Minimum sum ending exactly at index i.

    # Initialize arrays (using 0-based indexing)
    S_pos = [0] * N
    S_neg = [0] * N

    # Base Case i=0 (index 1)
    S_pos[0] = A[0]
    S_neg[0] = A[0]

    if N > 1:
        # Base Case i=1 (index 2)
        # S_pos(2) = a_2 + max(0, a_1)

        # S_neg(2) = a_2 + min(0, a_1)
        S_neg[1] = A[1] + min(0, A[0])

    # Recurrence Relations (for i >= 2, corresponding to index 3)
    for i in range(2, N):
        a_i = A[i]
        
        # S_pos(i) = a_i + max(0, S_pos(i-1), S_pos(i-2))

        S_neg[i] = a_i + min(0, S_neg[i-1], S_neg[i-2])

    M_A = 0
    for i in range(N):
        M_A = max(M_A, abs(S_pos[i]), abs(S_neg[i]))
        
    return M_A
